'''DrunkEwok A Better TRM''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[DrunkEwok]]
* '''Published:''' 26 February 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS5]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS5 TRM DrunkEwok LS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Wokling (V), Leia (V), For Luck (V), Flash Of Insight (V), Sabotage (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

Fiarly standard TRM, haven't seen a decent one posted in a while so i figured i'd post mine.

== Notes ==

* Posted 'Leia v' dested Leia (V) (Virtual Set 3), not Princess Leia (V); Naked 3p0 dested Threepio With His Parts Showing; Han with blaster dested Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; Alter (cor) dested Alter (Coruscant printing); One the edge dested On The Edge; Phylo gandidh dested Phylo Gandish.
* Original-era (V) cards (marked 'v'): Wokling (V), For Luck (V), Sabotage (V) and Leia (V) to Virtual Set 3; Flash Of Insight (V) to Virtual Set 5.
* The strategy says to start For Luck (V) instead of the Colo Claw Fish against Senate or walkers.

== Strategy ==

vs anything that sits at nonbattle grounds, ie senate or walkers start for luck v instead of the fish. Rest of the game is fairly strait forward, pull the docking bay, draw for twixes, use the 2 location and 1 3p0 pullers.  Battle with the epps and screaming guys.  Retrive with on draw thier fire, on the edge and flash.  Some match ups and card choices: Valorum + bacta tank for hit and runs vs senate, also ve senate epp luke + epp obi + gift of the mentor and some tracking can clear the senate.  VS walkers flash + sabotage + for luck + 3p0 will allow you to kill the cannon every turn till they grab sabotage.  VS anything in space load up home one with epp han + chewie, you'll get 2 destiny, 3 if lando there each is +2.  with a bunch of other guys on as forfit fodder you will slowly beat then off systems.
